snippet.title: Nyghtmare The Ninth King - Trailer - Physical Cart - Gameboy Color
snippet.description:
I made my own trailer, it,s kinda iffy, but here you go!

Nyghtmare: The Ninth King is a dark-fantasy, classic-vania, action-platform game that aims to make an authentic GameBoy [COLOR] retro feel that is as close as possible to the original. [NES Castlevania and MegaMan!]

Digital Rom is available here:
https://elvies.itch.io/nightmare-tnk-gbc
Order a Physical Cart here:
https://yastuna-games.com/en/home/73-nyghtmare-the-ninth-king.html
OST here:
https://bscarell.itch.io/nyghtmare-the-ninth-king-ost

Trailer Music by my friend:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MVyxczUXO4Y
